title: Lost, Refused and Returned-to-Sender Marketplace Orders Shipments
content:
**Policy.** A Marketplace Orders shipment still not delivered on the item-not-received wait days after the promised delivery date may be reported lost and is moved to undeliverable with the exception lost in transit. A lost or destroyed shipment is refunded in full (item, original shipping and tax), or replaced where the replacement policy allows, funded by the option's liability party. A shipment returned to sender for a bad address or refused by the buyer is refunded for the item and tax once the seller or the returns center records it as received; the original shipping is refunded only when the option's setting for refunding shipping on undeliverable orders is true, and a refusal of a non-defective item is treated as a remorse return for deductions.

## Outcomes by carrier exception

| Exception | Refund | Original shipping | Funded by | Other |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| lost in transit, or destroyed | in full: item, original shipping and tax (or a replacement where the replacement policy allows) | refunded | the option's liability party | — |
| returned to sender for a bad address | item and tax, once recorded as received by the seller or the returns center | only where the option's setting is true | — | — |
| refused by the buyer | item and tax, once recorded as received | only where the option's setting is true | — | a refusal of a non-defective item is treated as a remorse return for deductions |

## Hypothetical reading of the wait

On a hypothetical order with a promised delivery date of 10 August and an item-not-received wait of 2 days, a shipment still not delivered on 12 August may be reported lost. On 11 August the wait has not yet run. The dates are example inputs.
